versions.changelog:
Initial release of geekbi-aliexpress-shop-search-skill:

- Enables viewing and analyzing AliExpress shop details and product structures using 极鲸云.
- Supports research on shop sales, revenue, ratings, followers, product count, category structure, and operational trends.
- Requires shop ID or product ID; shop name search is not supported.
- Clearly outlines analysis boundaries and principles to ensure accurate interpretation of results.
- Excludes order, advertisement, or seller-center write operations.
